name: agentic-bookmarks
description: Durable bookmarks that survive refactors, share via git, and work with your AI coding agents through MCP.

agenticBookmarks.lineCacheLength.description: Number of characters from the line to cache on bookmark creation. Used to derive labels for unlabeled bookmarks.

agenticBookmarks.updateLineCacheOnEdits.description: When enabled, recomputes anchor.lineCache for affected bookmarks when editing lines or when anchors shift. Avoids writing if the value is unchanged.

agenticBookmarks.delayedExtraRefresh.description: If true, performs an extra delayed (150ms) gutter reapply to win decoration ordering. Disable to reduce flicker.

agenticBookmarks.noteDecorationMaxLength.description: Maximum character length for note decorations. Longer notes will be truncated at word boundaries with ellipsis (...). Full text is visible in the bookmarks tree view.

agenticBookmarks.notePlacement.description: Controls where bookmark note decorations appear relative to the bookmarked line.

agenticBookmarks.noteStartColumn.description: Column offset (in monospace characters) where note decorations begin. Values larger than noteDecorationMaxLength automatically expand the available note width by 20 characters.

agenticBookmarks.overviewRulerLane.description: Which lane of the overview ruler (mini-scrollbar) bookmark marks appear in. 'full' spans all lanes.

agenticBookmarks.dataRoot.description: Root directory for bookmark data files, relative to workspace root. Change this if your project already uses .bookmarks for something else.

agenticBookmarks.anchors.MCPcanEditTagsD.description: Allow MCP server to edit source files when creating tag anchors. When false (default), MCP returns the tag comment for the agent to insert.

agenticBookmarks.anchors.blankLinesUseSu.description: When bookmarking blank lines, anchor to the nearest non-blank line and store an offset. Disable to allow empty lineCache in smart anchors.

agenticBookmarks.autoRepair.description: Automatically attempt to repair broken smart anchors when files are opened. Uses context-search (always available) and optionally git history analysis (see autoRepairCanUseGit).

agenticBookmarks.autoRepairCanUseGit.markdownDescription: Allow auto-repair to use git history analysis (blame, line tracing through patches) as an enhancement. When **disabled**, auto-repair still runs using context-search alone — only git operations are skipped. When **enabled**, git-trace is used as a fallback when context-search confidence is low.
agenticBookmarks.autoRepairCanUseGit.description: Allow auto-repair to use git history analysis (blame, line tracing) as an enhancement. When disabled, auto-repair still runs using context-search alone. When enabled, git-trace is used as a fallback when context-search confidence is low.

agenticBookmarks.autoRepairCanCrossFileS.markdownDescription: Allow auto-repair to search across all changed files when a bookmark's target file is missing and git rename detection alone didn't find it. When **enabled**, auto-repair searches diff activity (added lines) across the workspace to find where code may have moved. More expensive than rename detection but catches copy-then-delete scenarios. Requires `autoRepairCanUseGit` to be enabled.

agenticBookmarks.showWarningIndicators.description: Show visual indicators (? overlay) on bookmarks with low-confidence anchor matches.

agenticBookmarks.showCommandsInContextMe.description: Show bookmark commands (Toggle, Toggle Labeled, Jump to Next/Previous, List in file) in the editor body right-click context menu. Off by default to avoid menu clutter; the line-number gutter menu is unaffected.

agenticBookmarks.hotkeyStyle.description: Built-in keybinding preset. 'basic' uses single-press shortcuts like Ctrl+Alt+K / Ctrl+Alt+L / Ctrl+Alt+J (default; closer to other bookmark extensions). 'chorded' uses Ctrl+K Ctrl+B-style chord shortcuts. 'custom' keeps the chorded defaults active and surfaces a 'Customize Keybindings…' command that opens VS Code's Keyboard Shortcuts UI pre-filtered to this extension's commands.

agenticBookmarks.logLevel.description: Controls the verbosity of messages written to the Agentic Bookmarks output channel. 'error' shows only failures, 'info' adds startup and command messages, 'debug' adds per-operation summaries, 'trace' adds per-bookmark iteration details.

agenticBookmarks.focusSetsDefault.description: When focusing on a group, also set it as the default target for new bookmarks.

agenticBookmarks.navigateThroughAllFiles.description: When jumping with Bookmarks: Jump to Next / Previous, navigate across all registered files. When false, navigation stays within the current file.

agenticBookmarks.wrapNavigation.description: When jumping with Bookmarks: Jump to Next / Previous, wrap from the last bookmark to the first (and vice versa).

agenticBookmarks.revealLocation.description: Where the bookmarked line appears in the editor after a jump.

agenticBookmarks.licensing.testTier.description: [Dev only] Simulated license tier. 'auto' defers to the real license check (currently a Phase 1 stub that always returns 'free'). Replaced by real license checking in SML-1300.

agenticBookmarks.licensing.testVisibilit.description: [Dev only] Simulated repo visibility. 'auto' defers to the real workspace visibility detector (git remote + HTTPS HEAD probe). Pick public/private/local to force a value for testing.

agenticBookmarks.licensing.devCommandsEn.description: [Dev only] Force-show the agenticBookmarks.testLicense.* commands in the palette even when the extension is in production mode. Normally these auto-show in development/test mode.

agenticBookmarks.confirmClear.description: When true, show a confirmation prompt before bulk-clearing bookmarks (Bookmarks: Clear / Clear from All Files). Disable to skip the prompt.

agenticBookmarks.export.pattern.markdownDescription: Template used to render each bookmark line in `Agentic Bookmarks: Export to Markdown…`. Supported variables: `${file}` (workspace-relative path), `${line}` (1-based line number), `${endLine}` (1-based end line for ranges, equals `${line}` otherwise), `${label}`, `${group}`, `${note}`. Unknown placeholders are left verbatim. Trailing whitespace is trimmed automatically.

agenticBookmarks.sortMode.allBookmarks.description: Sort mode for the All Bookmarks tree. 'user' enables drag-to-reorder; 'default' uses path/line ordering; 'recent' sorts by last-updated descending.

agenticBookmarks.sortMode.filesAndGroups.description: Sort mode for the Files & Groups tree. 'user' enables drag-to-reorder; 'default' uses name/line ordering; 'recent' sorts by last-updated descending.

agenticBookmarks.dev.enableMultiSelectDr.description: [Dev only] Enable multi-select drag in the bookmark trees. Right-click / context-menu commands are not yet multi-select aware — leave off in production.
